column1: # ReFix mod catalog: AutoDeploy installs the first row that matches the game.
#   product     lan, online or any: the ReFix product the mod needs
#   exe         the game's executable; the package goes to <its folder>\refix_mods
#   match_file  optional, relative to the exe folder: the row only matches when this file contains match_text
#   match_text  optional text looked for in match_file (game version, edition...)
#   file        package in refix_mods/ (next to AutoDeploy, else downloaded from this folder of the repository)
#   sha256      SHA-256 of the package; a download that does not match is discarded
